subject: BrightPath discovery — pricing & token-volume recap
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Miller <alice@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: BrightPath discovery — pricing & token-volume recap

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on pricing inputs before I send an estimate: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use: clinical triage assistant (note: some prompts may include PHI).
- Traffic shape: pilot ~100k requests/month, production target 1M–3M requests/month within 6–12 months (bursty daytime traffic).
- Avg tokens per request (estimated): 250–450 tokens (prompt + response).
- Key constraint: procurement wants a predictable $/1M-token target and clarity on committed vs on-demand pricing.

What we need from you (action items):
1) Confirm monthly budget range (ballpark is fine) so we can show scenarios.
2) If possible, upload a short sample of typical prompts/responses — I attached a simple token-volume template to make that easier.

Attached: BrightPath_token_volume_template.xlsx — fill in a couple of rows and send back; that will let us produce a more accurate cost breakdown.

Next steps (proposed):
- You share budget band + sample by EOD Thu (Oct 2).
- I’ll run three scenarios (pilot, steady-state conservative, steady-state optimistic) and return a line-item estimate + an invoice-style rough cut by end of day Fri.

If the team prefers committed pricing, we’ll include a 3-tier commit proposal (monthly committed tokens with step discounts).

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernández
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Diego@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: BrightPath_token_volume_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Alice Miller <alice@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>, BrightPath Procurement <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath discovery — pricing & token-volume recap

Thanks Diego — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Budget: procurement asked for a ballpark today — currently thinking $6k–$18k/month for inference during the first year, depending on quality/latency tradeoffs and whether we commit.
2) Volumes: pilot will be ~75k–120k requests/month; target in 12 months is closer to 1.2M–2.4M requests/month (we currently estimate average ~320 tokens/request).
3) Data sensitivity: yes some PHI. We will need the private deployment or dedicated capacity option documented in the estimate.

I’ve attached a small sample of 25 anonymized prompt/response pairs and our internal monthly traffic projection (BrightPath_usage_sample.csv). Can you show cost modeled both for hosted (fastest path) and dedicated (SLA/private) options?

We’re eager to see an invoice-style number we can take to procurement — ideally a 1M-token price reference.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Miller
Senior Product Manager, BrightPath Health
alice@brightpathhealth.com
Attachment: BrightPath_usage_sample.csv (csv stub)

From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Miller <alice@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath discovery — pricing & token-volume recap

Alice — appreciate the fast follow-up and the sample. I ran the initial pass using the sample and the ranges you supplied. High-level takeaways (attached are the two artifacts: RW_pricing_calc_v3.csv and a short cost breakdown PDF):

Assumptions used for the scenarios: avg tokens/request = 320 (sample mean), pilot volume = 100k req/mo, steady = 1.5M req/mo. Pricing shown for Hosted (on-demand) and Dedicated (reserved capacity) execution. PHI = reserved/dedicated required in quotes.

Scenario A — Hosted (on-demand):
- Model class: mid-size LLM profile (cost-conscious)
- Effective unit cost: $28 per 1M tokens (this reflects our hosted list with typical batching and caching but no long-term commit).
- Pilot estimate: ~32M tokens/month -> list cost ≈ $896/mo
- Steady estimate (1.5M req/mo -> 480M tokens/mo) -> list cost ≈ $13,440/mo

Scenario B — Dedicated (reserved capacity, PHI):
- Committed model pool with guaranteed latency and private environment
- Example committed tiers (illustrative):
  * 100M committed tokens/mo -> effective $/1M = $18 (commit discount + improved packing)
  * 300M committed tokens/mo -> effective $/1M = $12
- For steady 480M tokens/mo, blended example: 300M at $12 + 180M at $18 -> blended ≈ $13,320/mo (but with higher SLA and private tenancy).

Notes / caveats:
- These are invoice-style rough cuts; final numbers depend on exact prompt distributions, percent of cached prefixes, and RU (re-request) patterns.
- If BrightPath can commit to a 12-month ramp with minimum monthly commit of 200M tokens after month 3, we can show deeper discounts (I sketched these in RW_pricing_calc_v3.csv).

I attached a one-page BrightPath_cost_breakdown.pdf that maps tokens->requests->monthly fee for the three scenarios (pilot/steady/on-demand vs commit). Also attached the raw calc so you can edit inputs locally.

If this aligns directionally, I’ll convert Scenario B into an invoice-style PDF with line items (subscription, committed tokens, overage rate) and include contract language for private deployment.

Best — Diego
Diego Fernández
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: RW_pricing_calc_v3.csv; BrightPath_cost_breakdown.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Alice Miller <alice@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T12:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath discovery — pricing & token-volume recap

Diego / team — quick internal note and minor adjustment to the committed tiers before we finalize the invoice:

- We can offer a structured commit discount: 3-month ramp with a minimum commit of 150M tokens/mo after ramp yields $14/1M; 12-month commit at 300M/mo yields $9/1M. These assume standard GPU fit and modest quantization (no accuracy impact expected for the mid-size profile).
- Add a one-time onboarding fee for private deployment (network & KMS setup) — suggested $6,000 (one-time).

I’ve attached a cleaned workbook (RW_pricing_calc_commit_v2.xlsx) that shows the blended math and a simple 'invoice view' tab. If Alice is okay with the commit tiers I mentioned, we can produce a formal estimate with payment terms and SLA language.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
Attachment: RW_pricing_calc_commit_v2.xlsx

From: Alice Miller <alice@brightpathhealth.com>

Thanks Diego and Karthik — this is very helpful and the files look clear. Procurement asked for two outputs: 1) a one-page invoice-style estimate they can sign off on for procurement review, and 2) a short appendix that documents the PHI handling / private deployment steps and the one-time onboarding cost.

Next milestone for us: procurement will review the one-page estimate and come back with either a target commit level or questions by Tuesday COB. Can you please convert the committed 12-month 300M/mo example into an invoice PDF with payment terms, and include the onboarding fee as a separate line? If you can get that to us by Mon EOD that would be ideal.

I’ll circulate internally and loop procurement in once we have the invoice PDF.

— Alice
Alice Miller
Senior Product Manager, BrightPath Health
